note: SELECT version() in the pinned @duckdb/duckdb-wasm. etl/pyproject.toml pins the Python duckdb package to the same engine; queries.test.ts and etl/tests/test_queries.py check both.

extensions.note: DuckDB-WASM loads read_parquet's extension at runtime. scripts/duckdb-extensions.mjs downloads these official builds for the engine above at build time, checks them against these SHA-256s, and the site serves them itself (public/duckdb-extensions), so visitors' browsers never call extensions.duckdb.org.
